entry.title: New: Resolution 282 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE PAYMENT OF FUNDS OF A LATER FISCAL YEAR AND OF MORE THAN ONE FISCAL YEAR FOR A MULTI-YEAR LEASE FOR ONE LANDFILL COMPACTOR FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF ENVIRONMENTAL MANAGEMENT

Authorizes the Mayor to enter into a five-year lease agreement at an approximate monthly cost of $25,000 to replace equipment deemed inoperable due to fire loss.
